Newsom Orders AI Oversight, Explore ‘Kill Switch’

On Friday, Newsom signed the executive order directing California officials to speed up implementation of two AI laws enacted last week that establish independent verification organizations and a registry for AI auditors.
The order also calls for a group of experts to develop recommendations within two months.
The recommendations will examine whether frontier AI companies should have independent evaluators working onsite and whether their most advanced models should have an emergency shutdown mechanism.
Newsom said the state needs to act because Washington has not established what he considers sufficient federal AI oversight.
"The federal government’s abject failure to create any form of meaningful AI oversight or accountability should alarm every American," Newsom said.
